relationships.evidence_quote: EA therapy could reduce the production of IL-1β and TNF-α, although IL-6 levels remained unchanged

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that EA predominantly inhibits pyroptosis in microglia rather than neurons or astrocytes.

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavioral analysis results indicated that, both EA treatment and MCC950 treatment significantly ameliorated mechanical and thermal pain of CCI rats

key_findings: EA reduced pain hypersensitivity and spinal NLRP3, cleaved caspase-1, N-GSDMD, IL-1beta, IL-18 and TNF-alpha in CCI rats.
EA acts mainly on microglia not neurons/astrocytes; MCC950 gave no additive effect, consistent with NLRP3-dependent mechanism.
